sentences.text: Researchers developed TransA-MERFISH, a technique that integrates a fluorescent tracer with spatial transcriptomics to map neural circuits.
Using this method, the study identified the specific cell types in the superior colliculus that receive connections from four subclasses of retinal ganglion cells.

The mapping revealed that on-off direction-selective ganglion cells connect to some direction-selective cells in the superior colliculus but not to a specific cell type previously thought to be strongly direction-selective.
Experiments that removed the retinal direction-selective circuits showed that dependent and independent direction-selective cell types are mixed together in the superior colliculus.
